scope: Bounded visual inspection of six original packaged UI stills at 1600x900. Separate from automation, native input, moving review and overall release acceptance.
method: All six images were opened individually at original resolution through view_image. No earlier-source images, edits, crops or replacement pixels were used.

viewed_files.observation: Round 0/0 LEFT, yellow unpadded 0 POINTS, health +100, large M1911 7 / 56, highlighted slot 1 and slot 2 EMPTY are readable within separated panels. H SANDBOX is visible.

HELP + SANDBOX, control lines, enemy/weapon/points/scene groups and hotkey badges fit within the centered tray. Next box: RANDOM and the separated Back to game button are complete over the dimmed arena/HUD.
The tray is closed. Yellow 1500 POINTS has no leading zeros; points, health +100, M1911 7 / 56 and two slots retain separate regions.
PAUSED, Round 0, 0 KILLS, 1500 Points and Survived 0m 3s are complete. Resume/Esc, Restart/Enter and Quit/Q fit in separate aligned rows over the dimmed scene.

GAME OVER, Round 0, 0 KILLS, 550 Points and Survived 0m 4s are complete. Try again/Enter and Quit/Q remain separated; background health is zero. The 550 points agrees with the companion report's 950-point box activation after 1500.
Menus and dimming are gone. Round 0, 0 points, health +100, M1911 7 / 56 and empty slot 2 return; previous 1500/550-point values and the death panel are absent visually.

public_copy_verification: Each of the four repository PNG copies was hashed and confirmed byte-identical to its named original capture. Repository preparation does not itself establish commit, remote LFS upload or public release completion.
conclusion: No visible clipping, omitted required glyphs, padded point values or unintended panel overlap was observed in these six stills.
fixture_disclosure: Production Controller InputKey and cursor targeting are scripted, not native OS input. The tools grant 10000 points; an explicit 8500 spend exposes 1500. A safe-contact teleport and actual Hold F start a paid 950-point box roll before an explicit fatal-damage fixture. This review introduces no new gameplay or images.
limits: Six static views at 1600x900 only; other viewports, dim gameplay, high/long values and smaller physical displays need separate review.
Small control/hotkey labels remain subordinate to the primary values. Physical-display readability was not established.
No consecutive animation frames, active reel, Ready reward or Hold F prompt are shown; their timing and readability are outside this review.
Automation checks and source binding do not substitute for native control testing, auditory review, performance measurement or user approval of art/game feel.
Only in-engine PNG identities and portable record names are included; no desktop or operating-system security image is part of this evidence.
